thread:
marie: Created RC candidate for promo window tomorrow 2026-06-16 01:00-03:00 UTC. Build sha: b7f9c3a. Requesting signoff: eng (runtime change), QA (smoke/regressions), SRE (KV warm + rollback policy). Also need release-note delta approval and artifact pin.

marie: Release-note delta (short):
- streaming: change from batch-flush to incremental-flush to cut p99 latency ~3%
- fallback: add streaming fallback route to redwood-small-v1 when mem pressure > 85%
- misc: minor tokenizer patch for CLI examples (non-customer-facing)

alex: saw the runtime patch, perf on staging looks good (3% p99 drop). No model architecture changes. I can be on-call during promo window.

elaine: QA smoke run started on staging. I'll post quick checklist when done. Initial run: generator smoke ✅, embeddings sanity ✅, structured outputs spot-check 1/10 flaky (tokenization rounding) — not blocking.

rahul: SRE notes: we should KV-warm before traffic shift. Plan: run kv-warm job at T-35m (00:25 UTC), target 75% key coverage, TTL 2h. If warm fails, we hold promo and switch traffic to fallback pool. Also adding circuit breaker: if 5xx rate > 1% for 5m, auto-rollback to previous pinned sha.

marie: thanks. Adding artifact pin command below — please don't run until I say go: 
```
rdwctl pin artifact b7f9c3a --env prod --expires 72h --note "rc/2026-06-16 streaming fallback"
```

marie: rollback runbook (short):
1) rdwctl route set default --artifact <previous-sha>
2) rdwctl unpin artifact b7f9c3a --env prod
3) escalate to oncall/sheriff and notify customers per incident template: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback

alex: small ask — ensure streaming fallback has structured output header enabled, otherwise downstream parsers may error. I tested locally with fallback and parser tolerated it, but better to be explicit.

marie: good catch. Elaine, can you include a quick parse test in the post-smoke?

elaine: will add parse smoke (2 runs). Post-smoke I'll paste results here.

deploy-bot: artifact b7f9c3a pinned to prod by marie via rdwctl (expires 72h). Promo window: 2026-06-16 01:00-03:00 UTC.

rahul: I scheduled the kv-warm job at 00:25 UTC and a healthcheck ramp at 01:05 UTC (10% traffic), then 30/60/100. Healthcheck thresholds: latency p95 <= 1.2x baseline, error rate < 0.5%. If thresholds breach, system will pause and alert.

elaine: post-smoke parse test: run1 OK, run2 OK (minor CLI rounding still present). No blocking regressions found. +1 from QA.

alex: +1 from eng for runtime + fallback header config. I'll be available in the window.

rahul: +1 SRE on KV-warm and circuit settings. I'll watch the alerts and be ready to execute rollback if necessary.

marie: all signoffs received. I'll trigger promotion steps at start of window. Reminder: keep quiet channel open and no non-urgent changes during 00:00-04:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: scheduled promotion job created (job id: promo-1719998000). Will start at 2026-06-16T01:00:00Z unless canceled.

marie: starting manual pre-promo checklist at T-10m: confirm pin, kv-warm success, logs flowing to console, canary route ready.

deploy-bot: kv-warm job completed (success). 75% key coverage achieved.

deploy-bot: pre-promo healthcheck: staging baseline matched, no elevated error rates.

marie: initiating promotion. rdwctl promote --artifact b7f9c3a --to prod --canary 10%

deploy-bot: promotion started: canary 10%. Monitoring hooks enabled.

rahul: watching metrics — canary 10% stable for 5m. Proceeding to 30%.

deploy-bot: canary 30% complete and stable.

alex: verifying streaming p99 looks good on canary hosts. No regressions.

deploy-bot: traffic switched to 100% for artifact b7f9c3a. Promotion complete.

marie: promotion success. Updating release notes and closing RC candidate. Thanks everyone.

elaine: will kick off post-deploy regression run and post results here.

rahul: leaving the circuit breaker in place for 2 hours. If anything pops, I'll trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: note: artifact b7f9c3a will be auto-unpinned in 72h unless extended.

marie: final: release-note URL: https://redwood.internal/releases/rc-2026-06-16/b7f9c3a (filled). Thread closed after post-deploy checks. :tada:
